news.title: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA
news.summary: Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem. The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles. These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production. Samsung Advanc

title: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA

scenes.narration: Tech news you need to know. Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA.
Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem.
The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles.
These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production.
This was announced by NVIDIA Blog.
